```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis")
# Chunks below write LaTeX; wrap their output so pandoc passes it through unchanged
knitr::knit_hooks$set(rawlatex = function(before, options) if (before) "\n```{=latex}\n" else "\n```\n")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})

sample   <- params$sample
top_n    <- as.integer(params$top_n)
res_dir  <- file.path("results", sample)
ace_dir  <- file.path(res_dir, "QDNAseq_ACE")
logo     <- normalizePath(file.path("scripts", "logo_header.png"), mustWork = FALSE)

# Escape text for LaTeX
tex <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- "NA"
  x <- gsub("\\", "\001", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("([&%$#_{}])", "\\\\\\1", x)
  x <- gsub("~", "\002", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^", "\003", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\001", "\\textbackslash{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\002", "\\textasciitilde{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub("\003", "\\textasciicircum{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
out <- function(...) cat(..., sep = "")
num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ","))
}
int <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ","))
}
read_tsv_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
}
# First column whose name matches one of the candidates (case-insensitive)
pick <- function(df, candidates) {
  hit <- match(tolower(candidates), tolower(names(df)))
  hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA)
  df[[hit[1]]][1]
}

# Classifier scores. Sturgeon writes comma-separated files, the public sturgeon-v2
# release tab-separated; both have one column per class plus a probe-count column.
# With several samplings (rows), scores are averaged, as the classifiers do.
read_scores <- function(path, probe_cols) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  header <- readLines(path, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
  df <- tryCatch(
    read.table(path, header = TRUE, sep = if (grepl("\t", header)) "\t" else ",",
               quote = "\"", comment.char = "", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  probe_col <- intersect(probe_cols, names(df))
  classes <- setdiff(names(df), c(probe_cols, "sample", "Sample_ID"))
  scores <- vapply(df[classes], function(v) mean(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v)), na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
  scores <- scores[!is.na(scores)]
  if (length(scores) == 0) return(NULL)
  list(
    table = data.frame(class = names(scores), score = unname(scores), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      arrange(desc(score)) %>% mutate(rank = row_number()),
    probes = if (length(probe_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[probe_col[1]]][1])) else NA,
    samplings = nrow(df)
  )
}

v1      <- read_scores(file.path(res_dir, "merged_probes_methyl_calls_general.csv"), c("number_probes"))
v2      <- read_scores(file.path(res_dir, "sturgeon_v2_outcome.csv"), c("probes", "number_probes"))
mgmt    <- read_tsv_safe(file.path(res_dir, "MGMT_analysis", "mgmt_prediction.tsv"))
ace     <- read_tsv_safe(file.path(ace_dir, "ACE_summary.tsv"))
cnv_qc  <- read_tsv_safe(file.path(ace_dir, paste0(sample, "_QDNAseq_QC.tsv")))
versions <- read_tsv_safe(file.path(res_dir, "software_versions.tsv"))

version_of <- function(component, field = "version") {
  if (is.null(versions)) return(NA)
  hit <- versions[versions$component == component, field, drop = TRUE]
  if (length(hit) == 0) NA else hit[1]
}
pipeline_label <- paste0(params$version,
  if (!is.na(version_of("NEURON", "details"))) paste0(" (", sub("^git commit ", "", version_of("NEURON", "details")), ")") else "")
container_label <- ifelse(is.na(version_of("Container")) || version_of("Container") %in% c("", "not found"),
                          "not recorded", version_of("Container"))
```

```{r key-results, rawlatex=TRUE}
out("\\section{Key results}\n")

classifier_card <- function(label, res, unit) {
  if (is.null(res)) return(c(label, "Not available", "No classifier output found"))
  top <- res$table[1, ]
  c(label, tex(top$class),
    paste0("Raw score \\textbf{", num(top$score, 4), "}\\enspace\\textbar\\enspace ", int(res$probes), " ", unit))
}
cards <- list(
  classifier_card(paste0("Sturgeon v1", if (nzchar(params$v1_model)) paste0(" \\textbar\\ ", tex(params$v1_model))), v1, "probes"),
  classifier_card(paste0("Sturgeon v2", if (nzchar(params$v2_model)) paste0(" \\textbar\\ ", tex(params$v2_model))), v2, "CpG sites")
)

if (!is.null(mgmt)) {
  cards[[3]] <- c("\\textit{MGMT} promoter", tex(pick(mgmt, "status")),
    paste0("P(methylated) \\textbf{", num(pick(mgmt, "probability"), 3), "}\\enspace\\textbar\\enspace ",
           num(pick(mgmt, "avg_percent"), 1), "\\% mean methylation"))
} else {
  cards[[3]] <- c("\\textit{MGMT} promoter", "Not available", "No MGMT prediction found")
}

if (!is.null(ace) && !is.na(pick(ace, "cellularity"))) {
  cellularity <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pick(ace, "cellularity")))
  cards[[4]] <- c("Tumour cell fraction (ACE)", paste0(num(100 * cellularity, 0), "\\%"),
    paste0("Ploidy \\textbf{", num(pick(ace, "ploidy"), 1), "}\\enspace\\textbar\\enspace estimated from the copy-number profile"))
} else {
  cards[[4]] <- c("Tumour cell fraction (ACE)", "Not available", "No ACE estimate found")
}

out("\\begin{tcbraster}[raster columns=2, raster equal height=rows, raster column skip=8pt, raster row skip=8pt]\n")
for (card in cards) out("\\resultcard{", card[1], "}{", card[2], "}{", card[3], "}\n")
out("\\end{tcbraster}\n")
```

```{r classifier-scores, rawlatex=TRUE}
out("\\section{Classifier scores}\n")
out("{\\small\\color{muted}The highest-scoring classes, with the raw score each classifier reports (0--1, ",
    "all classes sum to 1). The bar shows the same score on a 0--1 scale.}\\par\\vspace{2pt}\n")

score_table <- function(title, res, model, unit) {
  out("\\subsection{", title, "}\n")
  if (is.null(res)) {
    out("\\begin{notebox}No classifier output found for this sample.\\end{notebox}\n")
    return(invisible())
  }
  details <- c(
    if (nzchar(model)) paste0("model ", tex(model)),
    paste0(int(res$probes), " ", unit),
    paste0(nrow(res$table), " classes"),
    if (res$samplings > 1) paste0("mean of ", res$samplings, " samplings"))
  out("{\\footnotesize\\color{muted}", paste(details, collapse = "\\enspace\\textbar\\enspace "), "}\\par\\vspace{2pt}\n")

  bar_cm <- 4.5
  shown <- head(res$table, top_n)
  out("\\begin{tabularx}{\\linewidth}{r X r l}\n",
      "\\tableheader \\thcell{Rank} & \\thcell{Class} & \\thcell{Raw score} & \\thcell{Score (0--1)} \\\\\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(shown))) {
    s <- max(0, min(1, shown$score[i]))
    row <- c(shown$rank[i], tex(shown$class[i]), num(shown$score[i], 4),
             sprintf("\\scorebar{%.2fcm}{%.2fcm}", bar_cm * s, bar_cm * (1 - s)))
    if (i == 1) row[1:3] <- paste0("\\textbf{", row[1:3], "}")
    if (i %% 2 == 0) out("\\rowcolor{panel}")
    out(paste(row, collapse = " & "), " \\\\\n")
  }
  out("\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabularx}\n")
}
score_table("Sturgeon v1", v1, params$v1_model, "probes")
score_table("Sturgeon v2", v2, params$v2_model, "CpG sites")
```

```{r classifier-plots, rawlatex=TRUE}
out("\\newpage\n\\section{Classifier plots}\n")
plot_or_note <- function(title, path, height) {
  out("\\subsection{", title, "}\n")
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    out("\\begin{center}\\includegraphics[width=\\linewidth,height=", height,
        ",keepaspectratio]{", normalizePath(path), "}\\end{center}\n")
  } else {
    out("\\begin{notebox}Plot not found: ", tex(basename(path)), "\\end{notebox}\n")
  }
}
plot_or_note("Sturgeon v1", file.path(res_dir, "merged_probes_methyl_calls_general.pdf"), "0.4\\textheight")
plot_or_note("Sturgeon v2", file.path(res_dir, "sturgeon_v2_outcome.png"), "0.4\\textheight")
```

```{r cnv, rawlatex=TRUE}
out("\\newpage\n\\section{Copy-number profile}\n")
plot_or_note("QDNAseq copy-number profile", file.path(ace_dir, paste0(sample, "_CNV.png")), "0.42\\textheight")

kv_table <- function(rows) {
  out("\\begin{tabularx}{\\linewidth}{X r}\n")
  for (i in seq_along(rows)) {
    if (i %% 2 == 0) out("\\rowcolor{panel}")
    out("\\textcolor{muted}{", names(rows)[i], "} & \\textbf{", rows[[i]], "} \\\\\n")
  }
  out("\\end{tabularx}\n")
}

out("\\vspace{6pt}\\noindent\\begin{minipage}[t]{0.48\\linewidth}\n\\subsection{Tumour cell fraction and ploidy (ACE)}\n")
if (!is.null(ace)) {
  kv_table(c(
    "Cellularity"    = num(pick(ace, "cellularity"), 2),
    "Ploidy"         = num(pick(ace, "ploidy"), 1),
    "Model fit error" = num(pick(ace, c("error", "errorlist")), 4)))
} else out("\\begin{notebox}No ACE estimate found.\\end{notebox}\n")
out("\\end{minipage}\\hfill\\begin{minipage}[t]{0.48\\linewidth}\n\\subsection{Copy-number quality control}\n")
if (!is.null(cnv_qc)) {
  kv_table(c(
    "Expected noise (sigma)" = num(pick(cnv_qc, "expected_sigma"), 4),
    "Delta sigma"            = num(pick(cnv_qc, "delta_sigma"), 4),
    "Called segments"        = int(pick(cnv_qc, "called_segments"))))
} else out("\\begin{notebox}No QDNAseq QC found.\\end{notebox}\n")
out("\\end{minipage}\n")
```

```{r mgmt, rawlatex=TRUE}
out("\\section{\\textit{MGMT} promoter methylation}\n")
if (!is.null(mgmt)) {
  kv_table(c(
    "Status"                       = tex(pick(mgmt, "status")),
    "Probability of methylation"   = num(pick(mgmt, "probability"), 4),
    "Mean promoter methylation"    = paste0(num(pick(mgmt, "avg_percent"), 2), "\\%"),
    "CpG sites in promoter"        = int(pick(mgmt, "n_cpgs")),
    "Mean coverage per CpG"        = paste0(num(pick(mgmt, "avg_coverage"), 2), "$\\times$"),
    "CpGs used"                    = tex(pick(mgmt, "cpg_source"))))
  warn <- pick(mgmt, "warning")
  if (!is.na(warn) && nzchar(warn)) {
    # Messages are joined with "; ", but a message can itself contain "; "; split only where the next one starts
    items <- trimws(strsplit(as.character(warn), ";\\s*(?=[A-Z])", perl = TRUE)[[1]])
    items <- items[nzchar(items)]
    out("\\vspace{4pt}\\begin{notebox}\\textbf{Notes from the MGMT analysis}\\\\\n",
        paste0("-- ", tex(items), collapse = "\\\\\n"), "\\end{notebox}\n")
  }
} else out("\\begin{notebox}No MGMT prediction found.\\end{notebox}\n")
```

```{r software, rawlatex=TRUE}
out("\\newpage\n\\section{Software and reference data}\n")
if (!is.null(versions) && nrow(versions) > 0) {
  versions[is.na(versions)] <- ""
  # longtable, so the table can continue on the next page with the header repeated
  header <- "\\tableheader \\thcell{Component} & \\thcell{Version} & \\thcell{Details} \\\\\n"
  out("\\begingroup\\small\\setlength{\\LTpre}{0pt}\\setlength{\\LTpost}{0pt}\n",
      "\\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{4.4cm} >{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{5.4cm} ",
      ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{\\dimexpr\\linewidth-9.8cm-6\\tabcolsep\\relax}@{}}\n",
      header, "\\endfirsthead\n", header, "\\endhead\n")
  for (cat_name in unique(versions$category)) {
    out("\\multicolumn{3}{@{}l}{\\rule{0pt}{14pt}\\bfseries\\color{accent}\\footnotesize\\MakeUppercase{", tex(cat_name), "}} \\\\\n")
    rows <- versions[versions$category == cat_name, ]
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
      if (i %% 2 == 0) out("\\rowcolor{panel}")
      version <- tex(rows$version[i])
      if (startsWith(rows$version[i], "md5 ")) version <- paste0("\\texttt{\\footnotesize ", version, "}")
      # Long file names: allow line breaks after underscores and slashes
      breakable <- function(x) gsub("(\\\\_|/)", "\\1\\\\allowbreak{}", tex(x))
      out(breakable(rows$component[i]), " & ", version, " & \\textcolor{muted}{\\footnotesize ", breakable(rows$details[i]), "} \\\\\n")
    }
  }
  out("\\bottomrule\n\\end{longtable}\n\\endgroup\n")
} else {
  out("\\begin{notebox}Software versions were not recorded (software\\_versions.tsv not found).\\end{notebox}\n")
}

out("\\section{Methods and references}\n",
    "{\\small\n",
    "\\textbf{Classification.} Sturgeon (Vermeulen et al., \\textit{Nature} 2023) and Sturgeon v2 ",
    "(github.com/deRidderLab/sturgeon-v2), applied to nanopore methylation calls extracted with modkit.\\\\[2pt]\n",
    "\\textbf{\\textit{MGMT} promoter.} Logistic model on mean promoter methylation (Patel et al. 2022).\\\\[2pt]\n",
    "\\textbf{Copy number.} QDNAseq (Scheinin et al., \\textit{Genome Research} 2014) with CGHcall segment calls; ",
    "tumour cell fraction and ploidy with ACE (Poell et al. 2019).\\par}\n")
```
